name: showroom-persistence-e2e
description: R7-Y: end-to-end proof, in a real browser with real localStorage and real document loads, of the security-r7 S1/S2/S4 fixes (acb87003, 0177e0d8). Pass/fail is decided by reading localStorage directly (a fingerprint of the autosave slot: item count + hash of ids/defIds/positions/rotations/props + note), never the store. Phase 0 plays the SENDER: mints a 3-item showroom + editable link with window.__shareHash, a corrupted code (S4), a 2001-item payload encoded past the size budget (S2) and the heaviest furnish (maisonette, 149 items), then wipes the profile. STEP 9 is the CONTROL arm and runs first: plain editing must autosave and survive a reload, otherwise every later "unchanged" would be vacuous; STEP 4 carries a second, POSITIVE control (an editable #/design/ link IS persisted), proving the fingerprint sees writes. Then: 1 the original repro (showroom via a real load, every allowed interaction incl. walk mode, a light switch, a curtain and the design note, a synthetic pagehide flush; the autosave and sofa.floorplans.v1 must stay byte-identical, and the design must come back after a no-hash reload); 2a/2b a pending edit inside the 500 ms debounce, followed by a real load (pagehide flush) and by a live hash change (flushPendingAutosave); 5 the live-hash showroom path; 3 Make it mine -> reload -> the File saved-layouts recovery slot (real UI click) -> Restore mine off the toast; 4 editable link toast + Restore mine, and restore through File after a reload; 6 five link hops with 10 user slots saved: <=3 recovery slots, none of the user slots evicted, no orphaned payloads; 7 S2 refusal toast + nothing changed, heavy legit design still opens; 8 S4 corrupted codes (live editable, inside a showroom, at boot): design/viewOnly/undo/recovery slots untouched and the URL matches the session. Finally steps 1 and 3 again at 390x844 (mobile File sheet). Generated by a throwaway script; run with SHOT_VIEWPORT=1400,900 SHOT_URL=http://localhost:<port>/. Cloud sync is NOT exercised (needs a real account): showroomCloudSync.test.ts is the only coverage for that path.
